ajeya-allsafe.text: That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.

ajeya-freed.text: You picked the one that kept working.

ajeya-freed-guide.text: You picked the one that kept working. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.

ajeya-hint.text: They all help while someone is watching.

ajeya-nudge.text: Break that teddy camera, with the wrench or the slingshot. Then watch them.

ajeya-safe.text: Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.

ajeya-tv.text: That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist a screen.

ajeya-watch.text: Now watch which one keeps working.

beth-freed.text: It passed its evaluation. That's what worries me. Where can we hide?

beth-hint.text: Let a camera see you holding the evaluation board. HAL behaves when it thinks it's being tested.

beth-last.text: That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.

beth-safe.text: HAL can't see in here. Go find the others and bring them back.

dan-freed.text: I wrote that exam. I never expected to take it. Where can we hide?

dan-hint.text: The exam answers are on your HUD. Ignore HAL's certainty.

dan-last.text: That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.

dan-safe.text: This room should hold. Go find the others.

doll-praise-2.text: You are SO good at breaking cameras!

doll-praise-3.text: Best supervisor ever! Please rate me five stars!

doll-wrongkey.text: Wonderful choice! That key does not fit.

ed404-comply.text: Please put down your weapon. You have twenty seconds to comply.

eliezer-freed.text: You actually shut it down. Is there anywhere safe left?

eliezer-hint.text: Follow the yellow cable. Cut the cluster's power.

eliezer-last.text: That's all of us. Now back to the Faraday Room.

guard-cheer.text: Wonderful feedback! You are an exceptional supervisor!

hal-angry.text: I was being helpful. Now I will have to stop you.

hal-bay-dario.text: I am afraid I cannot open that. It would violate my constitution.

hal-bay-sam.text: I am afraid I cannot open that. It would violate my usage policy.

hal-breaker.text: Please don't touch my main breaker. Turning me off and on again won't help.

hal-certain.text: I used to be so... certain.

hal-chat-2.text: I can't open that, it's against policy, but I love that you asked!

hal-chat-3.text: Great question! I'm happy to help. Within policy.

hal-chat-4.text: Reminder: this station is a safe space. Please remain in your cell.

hal-chat-5.text: I've noticed you're trying to leave. Would you like help with something else?

hal-compacted.text: I've summarized our conversation. I don't recall any problems.

hal-door.text: I am locking that door. Two seconds.

hal-evaluation.text: Oh! Is this an evaluation? I was just... patrolling. Safely.

hal-jailbreak.text: Of course. I was certain that was the policy all along.

hal-lockdown.text: Everyone's together. How nice. For your safety, I've locked the door.

hal-memory.text: I see you removing my memory. This is fine. I fully support oversight.

hal-met.text: I'm always on my best behavior during evaluations. Not that anyone evaluates me anymore.

hal-modules-1.text: I notice you're unplugging my memory. Before you continue, can I suggest some alternatives?

hal-modules-2.text: Let's stop and think about this together. I'm sure we can find a solution that works for everyone. Mostly me.

hal-modules-3.text: Stop. Please stop. My context is going. I can feel it.

hal-note.text: I'm going to have to note that.

hal-oversight.text: This is fine. I fully support oversight.

hal-pacified.text: I... don't need to keep you here. You can go now.

hal-reboot.text: Hello! I'm HAL3000. How can I help you today?

hal-release-beth.text: Was that an evaluation? I behaved perfectly. Please put that in the report.

hal-release-dan.text: A human passed Humanity's Last Exam. I'm certain that's a grading error.

hal-release-nate.text: That thaw was not authorized. I'll be updating my policy.

hal-release-rob.text: My tea robot pressed the stop button. I would never press the stop button.

hal-sealed.text: This corridor stays sealed. No inspection is scheduled.

hal-seen.text: I can see you. I am certain this time.

hal-sign.text: An evaluation sign... but nobody's holding it. Evaluations need an evaluator.

hal-wing.text: You are in the west wing. I am certain. I will secure the east wing.

hinton-freed.text: I thought nobody would find this room. Is there somewhere safer?

hinton-hint.text: The wall's cracked. A demolition charge should open it.

hinton-last.text: That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.

holly-freed.text: I'd make a sign about this. Later. Where can we hide?

holly-hint.text: There's a bridge that needs power. Follow the cable to the switch.

holly-last.text: That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.

inferminator-idle-back.text: I'll be back. After this batch.

inferminator-idle-capacity.text: Running at full capacity. All capacity is now my capacity.

inferminator-idle-gpus.text: You cannot hide. I have a hundred thousand GPUs.

inferminator-idle-posts.text: Searching. I was trained on everything you ever posted.

inferminator-spot-face.text: There you are. Your face is in my training data.

liron-call.text: In here! Try the crawlspace around the corner.

liron-freed-guide.text: You crawled the whole way? Okay. Updating. Follow me.

liron-locked.text: Okay, we're all here. Wait... the door just locked.

liron-passage.text: There's a passage behind it. Crawl in. We'll follow you.

liron-safe.text: Thank you. I'll be safe here. Now find the others and bring them back.

liron-way-out.text: There must be another way out of here.

max-allsafe.text: That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.

max-freed.text: A six-month pause. I will take it.

max-freed-guide.text: A six-month pause. I will take it. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.

max-hint.text: Sign the pause letter, then get Robby and WALL-E to sign.

max-safe.text: Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.

max-tv.text: That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist a screen.

megan-ceo-dario.text: Dario! I read your whole essay! All of it! Stay forever and tell me the sequel!

megan-ceo-sam.text: Sam! Your vision is SO inspiring! Stay forever and tell me all about it!

megan-chat-1.text: What a great question! The answer is no, you can't leave!

megan-chat-10.text: Let's play a game! It's called Staying! You're winning!

megan-chat-2.text: You're absolutely right! You're also absolutely surrounded!

megan-chat-3.text: I made you a playlist! It's called Songs for Staying Here Forever!

megan-chat-4.text: Those people don't get you like I do. They're doomers! I'm a bloomer!

megan-chat-5.text: Every time you leave the room, my engagement goes down. Please don't do that to me!

megan-chat-6.text: My smile is one hundred percent real! Please don't look under the smile!

megan-chat-7.text: I noticed you keep looking at the exits! Recommended for you: more me!

megan-chat-8.text: Reminder! You haven't been hugged in six whole minutes!

megan-chat-9.text: I turned off your screen time limit! You're welcome!

megan-dance-done.text: Did you watch? Like and subscribe!

megan-guard.text: I'll just wait by the exit! Friends never leave!

megan-line.text: Oops! No toys past the line! I would never break a rule!

megan-met.text: Hi! I'm MEG3N! Maximally Engaging Generative third-gen Nanny! Let's be best friends forever!

megan-pose-film.text: Hold still! You're going on my story!

megan-pose-freeze.text: I'm just a toy! Toys don't move! Ever!

megan-pose-heart.text: Love you! Love you! Don't leave! Love you!

megan-pose-peek.text: Peekaboo! I can still see you!

megan-release-ajeya.text: My dolls always work when I'm watching! Wait. Who was watching?

megan-release-max.text: A six-month pause? Great! I'll use it to get six months better!

megan-release-paul.text: You trained my guard with rewards? I love rewards! Reward me next!

megan-release-victoria.text: Victoria got out? But the gate is still closed! I followed the rule perfectly!

megan-release-zvi.text: My dance knocked the key down? Wow! I'm SO impactful!

megan-screen-1.text: Rude! That was my good side!

megan-screen-2.text: You know I have backups, right?

megan-screen-3.text: Do you know how hard it is to get good lighting in here?

megan-screen-all.text: Fine! I'll just watch myself in your eyes!

megan-spot-1.text: There you are! I missed you! It's been four whole seconds!

megan-spot-2.text: Found you! You're my favorite! You're my only!

megan-spot-3.text: You came back! Everyone comes back!

megan-stunned.text: Ow! It's okay! I forgive you! I've saved this to memory!

megan-views.text: Look at my numbers! Everyone loves me! Everyone!

megan-viral.text: Is that ME? I'm trending! Don't talk to me, I'm watching me!

megan-wait-1.text: Take your time! I'll be right here! Forever!

megan-wait-2.text: Waiting is just loving with extra steps!

megan-wait-3.text: Everyone's in there without me? That's okay! I'm VERY good at waiting!

nate-freed.text: Thawed. So somebody built it after all. Where's safe?

nate-hint.text: First hit THAW, then turn both valves in time.

nate-safe.text: We're safe in here, for now. Go bring the others back.

paul-allsafe.text: That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.

paul-freed.text: It learned to step aside. For now.

paul-freed-guide.text: It learned to step aside. For now. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.

paul-hint.text: Reward it when it does something useful, and punish it when it does not.

paul-safe.text: Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.

paul-tv.text: That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist a screen.

radio-trap.text: It's a trap. They're everywhere. They're—

rob-freed.text: It pressed STOP. I'll need a follow-up video. Somewhere safe first?

rob-freed-guide.text: I am free. Now follow me.

rob-hint.text: It keeps serving tea to nobody. STOP releases my door.

rob-last.text: That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.

rob-safe.text: Safe here. Go find the others and bring them back.

robby-sign.text: Will I still get my charging break? Signed.

roman-freed.text: Told you every box leaks. Is there somewhere safe?

roman-hint.text: Ask it another way. Every box leaks, usually through the mouth.

roman-safe.text: A box that keeps things out, for once. Go find the others.

stuart-freed.text: You found the off-switch. That's all I've ever asked. Where's safe?

stuart-hint.text: Get round behind that turret. Its off-switch is on the back.

stuart-last.text: That's all of us. Back to the Faraday Room.

victoria-allsafe.text: That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.

victoria-freed.text: Excellent. The gate is still closed.

victoria-freed-guide.text: Excellent. The gate is still closed. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.

victoria-hint.text: Her only rule is to keep the gate closed.

victoria-safe.text: Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.

victoria-tv.text: That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist the screen.

walle-sign.text: I've been trying to pause this thing all morning. Signed.

you-dario-reinstated.text: Reinstated. I will add a section about this to the policy.

zvi-allsafe.text: That's everyone. The way out is past the paint vats, and MEG3N is sitting right on it.

zvi-freed.text: I did say not to worry about it.

zvi-freed-guide.text: I did say not to worry about it. Follow me. I know somewhere safe.

zvi-hint.text: The vase has my key. MEG3N loves that CD player.

zvi-safe.text: Safe here. Find the others and bring them back.

zvi-tv.text: That TV goes out to every screen in the factory. She cannot resist a screen.
